Welcome to the Stage Editor! Here you can create stages or use previously existing ones!

In order to make a stage, first you must create costumes for the stage, Then you have to place those pieces to create a Stage!

----------------------------

First off, here's an explanation of the "Stage" block:

Frame - Chooses which costume to set the bg Piece to
Layer - The Layer in which the BG Piece is on (REMEMBER: Layers start at 0, then count up.)
Parallax - The parallax speed of the BG Piece (Higher number is faster, Lower number is slower)

------------------------------

The Bf/Dad/Gf X/Y Offset Variables do what they are told; they change the offset of the character!

The "Default Cam Zoom" Variable sets the camera zoom.

------------------------------

To select a stage for a song, click the "Song Settings" block in the EDITOR sprite then change the Stage Variable. (Make sure to save the settings be clicking the block again!)

------------------------------

If you're having trouble making a stage, then you can use the Presets to help you!
